firstSteps: Run npm run dev to launch the extension
Open any page for the overlay, then click the toolbar icon for the popup
Add a file under scripts/ and it ships as its own bundle
useCases: Scripts shared between a popup and a content script
Standalone script bundles without manifest plumbing
Reference for the scripts/ special folder convention

store.summary: Runs bundled scripts from a toolbar popup.

justifications.activeTab: Grants temporary access to the page the user is on when they invoke the extension, so it can act on that page only.
justifications.scripting: Injects the extension's content script that renders its on-page interface.
justifications.Host permission <all_urls>: The content script runs on the pages the user visits to render the extension's on-page interface. Narrow this to the specific sites your extension needs before submitting.

versionHistory: 1.0.0 (unreleased): initial version from the special-folders-scripts template. Not yet submitted to any store.
